subject: Post-call exec recap: Redwood + Apex Retail — exec sponsor & procurement path
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@apexretail.com>, Sana Ahmed <sana.ahmed@apexretail.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Post-call exec recap: Redwood + Apex Retail — exec sponsor & procurement path

Hi Daniel and Sana,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Wanted to capture the key items for our execs and procurement so we have alignment on next steps. I copied Aditya and Vivek for visibility and any escalation help.

Summary of the call (high level)
- Business outcomes: reduce support-handling time by ~50% using LLM-assisted triage and response templates; target 30% reduction in agent AHT within Q4 after pilot.
- Primary pain: fragmented in-house search + outdated KB -> long resolution times and inconsistent answers.
- Success metrics: AHT reduction, CSAT +3-5 points, 30-day time-to-value for a scoped pilot.

Risks / compliance questions raised
- Data residency: Apex stores PII in EU and US. They need clarification on data retention and ability to pin traffic to a US-only environment for pilot.
- Security: they asked for SOC 2 and an architecture diagram for model isolation.
- Model provenance & hallucination risk: they want an evaluation plan and quality gates before wider rollout.

Procurement & timeline
- Exec sponsor: Daniel Park (SVP Product) — confirmed.
- Procurement contact: Sana Ahmed (Head of Procurement) — she will own the PO and legal review.
- Procurement path: internal procurement -> legal -> IT security sign-off -> standard SaaS + DPA. Targeting PO/contract by end of September.

Next steps (owner / ETA)
1) I will send a short SOW draft + pilot scope for review — Marissa (today EOD). [attachment: SOW-draft.pdf]
2) Security FAQ and SOC2 evidence — Redwood security to send to Sana + IT (Aditya to coordinate) — ETA: 3 business days.
3) Quick evaluation plan + quality gating proposal — Redwood product — ETA: 1 week.
4) Schedule technical deep-dive with Apex IT (network, VPC options) — propose Wed 8/19 — Action: Sana to confirm availability.

If this looks right I’ll proceed to share the SOW and loop in our security lead for the artifacts.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: SOW-draft.pdf

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@apexretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sana Ahmed <sana.ahmed@apexretail.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 12:10:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-call exec recap: Redwood + Apex Retail — exec sponsor & procurement path

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few items on our side:

- Exec sponsor: yes, I’m driving this from a product/ops point of view.
- Procurement: Sana will lead contracting and PO; we aim to have an internal legal touchpoint by 9/10.
- Data residency: For the pilot we prefer US-only processing if possible. For production we’ll need options for EU processing.
- Security artifacts: please share SOC 2 report and the architecture diagram. Our security team will review and come back with any questions.

A couple of asks from me:
1) Can you include a proposed success metrics dashboard in the SOW (AHT, CSAT, false positive rates) so we can align on measurement?
2) Is there a standard SLAs package for Dedicated vs Hosted? We’re trying to understand the tradeoffs for predictable latency vs cost.

Sana — looping you in to confirm availability for the technical deep-dive and to share procurement timeline.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
SVP, Product | Apex Retail
daniel.park@apexretail.com | +1 (212) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@apexretail.com>, Sana Ahmed <sana.ahmed@apexretail.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call exec recap: Redwood + Apex Retail — exec sponsor & procurement path

Internal/exec recap — quick summary and escalation requests. (Looping Daniel & Sana for transparency)

Why this matters (impact for Apex):
- Business outcome maps to a measurable cost saving and CS improvement: 30% AHT reduction target translates to ~ $1.2M annualized savings for their support organization (per our back-of-envelope).
- Strategic fit: Apex is standardizing on a single vendor for conversational assistance; this could be a reference account for retail vertical.

Open risks that may require escalation
1) Data residency: Apex requires US-only processing for pilot. Need confirmation from infra/security that we can pin nodes and provide a US-only environment for pilot workloads. (Requesting Aditya to coordinate with infra/security.)
2) SOC 2 evidence & architecture diagram: send the SOC 2 report + Redwood-Security-FAQ.pdf to Sana and Apex IT; expect follow-ups. (I will attach and ask security to jump in.)
3) SLA expectations: Daniel explicitly asked about Dedicated vs Hosted SLA/cost tradeoffs — recommend a short decision memo outlining latency SLAs, throughput, and cost delta for Dedicated reserved vs hosted on-demand. (Vivek / Product to own.)
4) Legal / DPA timeline: target internal legal review complete by 2026-09-10 if Apex can commit to that window — may need light redlines on our standard DPA.

Immediate actions (owners)
- Marissa: finalize SOW with pilot metrics and dashboard; include success criteria and measurement plan — due Fri 8/14 EOD. [SOW-draft.pdf attached]
- Aditya: coordinate SOC 2 + infra confirmation for US-only pilot and provide architecture diagram — ETA: 3 business days.
- Vivek: prepare a 1-page Dedicated vs Hosted decision memo (SLA/cost tradeoffs) — ETA: 1 week.
- Legal: prep DPA template and note any common customer redlines we should expect (I will loop legal once we have a PO).

If we can get the artifact set to Sana by next Wed (8/19) we should be on track for their internal legal review and a September PO.

Thanks — will update this thread as artifacts land.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: SOW-draft.pdf, Redwood-Security-FAQ.pdf
